notice: TEST FIXTURE - not actual market evidence
root_problem: competitor price and availability states are fragmented across storefronts
wedge: submit tracked product URLs and receive only verified price or stock exceptions
expansion: merchandising and replenishment decisions using verified exception history
originals: Every day I manually check multiple storefronts for competitor prices and stock, then copy the states into a spreadsheet. The work takes about 50 minutes.
Weekly we manually double-check six shops and track price or sold-out changes in Excel because the current alert tool is late. It takes 2 hours.
